Name: Meshullam, Son of Zerubbabel
Summary: Son of Zerubbabel, named in the post-exilic royal line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:19: Son of Zerubbabel, named in the post-exilic royal line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Meshullam stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
